data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nawz' meaning 'gift' or 'present'. It is often used as a given name for girls, evoking the idea of being a precious gift or blessing from Allah. The name NOT only reflects the value of the child, but also honors the belief that everything is a gift from Allah. Furthermore, it's a reminder of the importance of recognizing and appreciating the blessings that Allah has bestowed upon us.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Nawzaa" holds a deep significance in the Islamic faith. It is a reminder that each and every human being is a unique and precious creation of Allah. The name embodies the concept of tawakkul (trust in Allah) and shukr (gratitude) towards the Almighty. The child named "Nawzaa" is encouraged to live up to the name, by being a source of blessings and positivity to those around them, and by continually recognizing and appreciating the blessings they have been given by Allah. Overall, the name "Nawzaa" is a reminder of the beauty and power of belief in Allah's benevolence and the value of every human life.
